svg.title: Hover previews for each window
svg.desc: Hovering Safari in the Dock shows a preview of its two windows, Docs and Recipes, each with traffic lights. The cursor picks Recipes to focus that exact window. The DogBar dog lies in front of the screen and peeks up at the previews.
